name: Ivatch
description: Ivatch was a planet within the Kathol sector's Ivatch system, located within the Outer Rim Territories. Connected to the neighboring planets of Shintel and Peirs by hyperlanes, Ivatch supported a small colony whose economy was based around supplying ore and natural resources to Gandle Ott.
